title: finding(app-shell): `ObjectView`'s `filter[...]` memo key re-serializes params by hand, so a value containing `&` or `+` reaches the reader mangled
body:
Found while fixing objectui#9196 (dev seat). Filed rather than folded in: a
different mechanism in the same block, and fixing it would move the plain-equality
control that objectui#9196's acceptance depends on.

## The measurement

`ObjectView` builds a memo key over the `filter[...]` entries by hand, then re-parses
that string to get the params it reads:

```
packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx
    const filterParamsKey = Array.from(searchParams.entries())
        .filter(([k]) => k.startsWith('filter['))
        .map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`)
        .join('&');
    ... new URLSearchParams(filterParamsKey) ...
```

`entries()` yields DECODED values, and the join re-introduces the two characters that
are structural in a query string without re-encoding them. Run over one field with a
lit control in the same command:

| value in the URL | value the reader receives |
|---|---|
| LIT CONTROL `Acme` | `Acme` |
| `Smith & Sons` | `Smith ` |
| `A+B` | `A B` |
| `a=b` | `a=b` |
| `100%` | `100%` |
| `a b` | `a b` |
| `Unicode with diacritics` | unchanged |
| `a#b` | `a#b` |

The control reads the same on both sides of the mangling, so neither the two failures
nor the six clean rows are unmeasured cells.

An ampersand TRUNCATES the value at the first occurrence and leaves the remainder as a
stray empty-valued param; a plus becomes a space. Both directions produce a condition
that is silently WRONG rather than absent: the list renders, scoped by
`account_name = 'Smith '`, and nothing anywhere says the value was cut.

## Why this is a defect and not a style note

The block's own docblock states what it is for: "Used by related-list View All buttons
to scope the destination list to a single parent record." The value is therefore
whatever the parent key holds, and a text or name key holding an ampersand is ordinary
data, not a hostile input. The same URLs are an addressable public surface by design
(ADR-0055, and the operator contract of objectui#1752).

The memo key exists only to keep the memo from churning on unrelated `uf_*` params -
that purpose is served equally well by a key that round-trips, so the failure buys
nothing.

## Reachability

Reachable from in-app navigation, not only by a hand-written URL: any related-list
View All whose parent key value contains an ampersand or a plus. It is also reachable
by a bookmarked or copied URL, the same way objectui#9196 is.

## Deliberately NOT claimed here

Whether the repair is to build the key with `URLSearchParams` and read the params
object directly, or to keep a string key but encode it, is not asserted - both remove
the mangling and they differ in how much of the surrounding memo shape moves. Note that
objectui#9196 landed the reader for this family in `drillUrlFilters`, so the reader
half is no longer in this file; only the key construction is.
